classes.name: TransferBRep_BinderOfShape
classes.summary: Allows direct binding between a starting Object and the Result of its transfer when it is Unique. The Result itself is defined as a formal parameter <Shape from TopoDS> Warning : While it is possible to instantiate BinderOfShape with any Type for the Result, it is not advisable to instantiate it with Transient Classes, because such Results are directly known and managed by TransferProcess & Co, through SimpleBinderOfTransient : this class looks like instantiation of BinderOfShape, but its method ResultType is adapted (reads DynamicType of the Result).

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.comment: normal standard constructor, creates an empty BinderOfShape

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.comment: constructor which in the same time defines the result Returns True if a starting object is bound with SEVERAL results : Here, returns always False But it can have next results

instanceMethods.name: ResultType
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the Type permitted for the Result, i.e. the Type of the Parameter Class <Shape from TopoDS> (statically defined).

instanceMethods.name: ResultTypeName
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the Type Name computed for the Result (dynamic).

instanceMethods.name: SetResult
instanceMethods.comment: Defines the Result.

instanceMethods.name: Result
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the defined Result, if there is one.

instanceMethods.name: CResult
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the defined Result, if there is one, and allows to change it (avoids Result + SetResult). Admits that Result can be not yet defined Warning : a call to CResult causes Result to be known as defined.

classes.name: TransferBRep_Reader
classes.summary:
This class offers a simple, easy to call, way of transferring data from interface files to Shapes from CasCade It must be specialized according to each norm/protocol, by :
- defining how to read a file (specific method with protocol)
- definig transfer, by providing an Actor

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.comment: Initializes a non-specialised Reader. Typically, for each norm or protocol, is will be required to define a specific Create to load a file and transfer it.

instanceMethods.name: SetProtocol
instanceMethods.comment: Records the protocol to be used for read and transfer roots.

instanceMethods.name: Protocol
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the recorded Protocol.

instanceMethods.name: SetActor
instanceMethods.comment: Records the actor to be used for transfers.

instanceMethods.name: Actor
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the recorded Actor.

instanceMethods.name: SetFileStatus
instanceMethods.comment:
Sets File Status to be interpreted as follows : = 0 OK < 0 file not found.
0 read error, no Model could be created

instanceMethods.name: FileStatus
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the File Status.

instanceMethods.name: FileNotFound
instanceMethods.comment: Returns True if FileStatus is for FileNotFound.

instanceMethods.name: SyntaxError
instanceMethods.comment: Returns True if FileStatus is for Error during read (major error; for local error, see CheckModel).

instanceMethods.name: SetModel
instanceMethods.comment: Specifies a Model to work on Also clears the result and Done status.

instanceMethods.name: Model
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the Model to be worked on.

instanceMethods.name: Clear
instanceMethods.comment: clears the result and Done status. But not the Model.

instanceMethods.name: CheckStatusModel
instanceMethods.comment: Checks the Model. Returns True if there is NO FAIL at all (regardless Warnings) If <withprint> is True, also sends Checks on standard output.

instanceMethods.name: ModeNewTransfer
instanceMethods.comment: Returns (by Reference, hence can be changed) the Mode for new Transfer : True (D) means that each new Transfer produces a new TransferProcess. Else keeps the original one but each Transfer clears its (former results are not kept).

instanceMethods.name: BeginTransfer
instanceMethods.comment: Initializes the Reader for a Transfer (one,roots, or list) Also calls PrepareTransfer Returns True when done, False if could not be done.

instanceMethods.name: EndTransfer
instanceMethods.comment: Ebds a Transfer (one, roots or list) by recording its result.

instanceMethods.name: PrepareTransfer
instanceMethods.comment: Prepares the Transfer. Also can act on the Actor or change the TransientProcess if required. Should not set the Actor into the TransientProcess, it is done by caller. The provided default does nothing.

instanceMethods.name: TransferRoots
instanceMethods.comment: Transfers all Root Entities which are recognized as Geom-Topol The result will be a list of Shapes. This method calls user redefinable PrepareTransfer Remark : former result is cleared.

instanceMethods.name: Transfer
instanceMethods.comment: Transfers an Entity given its rank in the Model (Root or not) Returns True if it is recognized as Geom-Topol. (But it can have failed : see IsDone).

instanceMethods.name: TransferList
instanceMethods.comment: Transfers a list of Entities (only the ones also in the Model) Remark : former result is cleared.

instanceMethods.name: IsDone
instanceMethods.comment: Returns True if the LAST Transfer/TransferRoots was a success.

instanceMethods.name: NbShapes
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the count of produced Shapes (roots).

instanceMethods.name: Shapes
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the complete list of produced Shapes.

instanceMethods.name: Shape
instanceMethods.comment: Returns a Shape given its rank, by default the first one.

instanceMethods.name: ShapeResult
instanceMethods.comment: Returns a Shape produced from a given entity (if it was individually transferred or if an intermediate result is known). If no Shape is bound with <ent>, returns a Null Shape Warning : Runs on the last call to Transfer,TransferRoots,TransferList.

instanceMethods.name: OneShape
instanceMethods.comment:
Returns a unique Shape for the result :
- a void Shape (type = SHAPE) if result is empty
- a simple Shape if result has only one : returns this one
- a Compound if result has more than one Shape

instanceMethods.name: NbTransients
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the count of produced Transient Results (roots).

instanceMethods.name: Transients
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the complete list of produced Transient Results.

instanceMethods.name: Transient
instanceMethods.comment: Returns a Transient Root Result, given its rank (by default the first one).

instanceMethods.name: CheckStatusResult
instanceMethods.comment: Checks the Result of last Transfer (individual or roots, no cumulation on several transfers). Returns True if NO fail occurred during Transfer (queries the TransientProcess).

instanceMethods.name: TransientProcess
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the TransientProcess. It records information about the very last transfer done. Null if no transfer yet done. Can be used for queries more accurate than the default ones.

classes.name: TransferBRep_ShapeBinder
classes.summary: A ShapeBinder is a BinderOfShape with some additional services to cast the Result under various kinds of Shapes.

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.comment: Creates a ShapeBinder with a result.

instanceMethods.name: ShapeType
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the Type of the Shape Result (under {@link TopAbs | `TopAbs`} form).

classes.name: TransferBRep_ShapeInfo
classes.summary: Gives information on an object, see template DataInfo This class is for Shape.

staticMethods.name: Type
staticMethods.comment: Returns the Type attached to an object Here, TShape (Shape has no Dynamic Type).

staticMethods.name: TypeName
staticMethods.comment: Returns Type Name (string) Here, the true name of the Type of a Shape.

classes.name: TransferBRep_ShapeListBinder
classes.summary: This binder binds several (a list of) shapes with a starting entity, when this entity itself corresponds to a simple list of shapes. Each part is not seen as a sub-result of an independent component, but as an item of a built-in list.

instanceMethods.name: IsMultiple
instanceMethods.comment: Returns True if a Binder has several results, either by itself or because it has next results Can be defined by sub-classes.

instanceMethods.name: ResultType
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the Type which characterizes the Result (if known).

instanceMethods.name: ResultTypeName
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the Name of the Type which characterizes the Result Can be returned even if ResultType itself is unknown.

instanceMethods.name: AddResult
instanceMethods.comment: Adds an item to the result list.

instanceMethods.name: AddResult
instanceMethods.comment: Adds an item to the result list.

instanceMethods.name: SetResult
instanceMethods.comment: Changes an already defined sub-result.

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.comment: Creates a Mapper with a Value. This Value can then not be changed. It is used by the Hasher to compute the HashCode, which will then be stored for an immediate reading.

instanceMethods.name: Value
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the contained value.

instanceMethods.name: Equates
instanceMethods.comment: Specific test of equality : defined as False if <other> has not the same true Type, else contents are compared (by C++ operator ==).

instanceMethods.name: ValueType
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the Type of the Value. By default, returns the DynamicType of <me>, but can be redefined.

instanceMethods.name: ValueTypeName
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the name of the Type of the Value. Default is name of ValueType, unless it is for a non-handled object.

classes.name: TransferBRep_TransferResultInfo
classes.summary:
Data structure for storing information on transfer result. At the moment it dispatches information for the following types:
- result,
- result + warning(s),
- result + fail(s),
- result + warning(s) + fail(s)
- no result,
- no result + warning(s),
- no result + fail(s),
- no result + warning(s) + fail(s),

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.comment: Creates object with all fields nullified.

instanceMethods.name: Clear
instanceMethods.comment: Resets all the fields.
